78	
79	`bar` is `GridBarrier` over `ctx.n_ctas` (`megakernel_common.cuh:147`): its
80	`sync()` waits for **every** launched CTA. If a `tr.rendezvous(bar)` (which calls
81	`bar.sync()`) is placed INSIDE the per-tile loop, CTA `c` reaches it
82	`ceil((n_tiles-c)/nCTA)` times while CTA `c'` reaches it a different number of
83	times ⇒ the arrival count never equals `n_ctas` on a given generation ⇒ **deadlock**.
84	The loopback test (`tp_loopback_binding.cu:93`) sidesteps this by launching
85	exactly `grid = P` CTAs with **one tile in flight per PE** (no grid-stride) — so
86	its whole-grid `bar.sync()` IS a clean rendezvous. That is the persistent-kernel
87	shape `tp_layer.cuh` documents ("one tile in flight per PE").
88	
89	**⇒ On the `kTPComm` path the P1 tile loop must be GRID-LOCKSTEP: all CTAs on a
90	GPU process the SAME tile index together, with `tr.rendezvous(bar)` at the four
91	reduce points being a barrier every CTA reaches the SAME number of times.** Two
92	sub-cases, both spelled out in EDIT C.3:
93	
94	- **TP-only single-GPU loopback (the bring-up gate, `LoopbackTransport`):** the
95	  virtual PEs share ONE grid; CTAs are partitioned into `P` contiguous per-PE
96	  groups (`LoopbackTransport::pe_of_cta`). Within a PE group the CTAs that own a
97	  tile still must reach the rendezvous in lockstep — so the loop is restructured
98	  to `for (tile_round = 0; tile_round < n_rounds; ++tile_round)` where every CTA
99	  participates in each round's rendezvous even if its PE has no row in that round
100	  (it publishes a zero-length partial / skips the GEMM but STILL calls
101	  `tr.rendezvous(bar)`). `n_rounds = ceil(n_tiles_per_pe)` is a GRID-UNIFORM
102	  count (all PEs have the same tile count because `T` is replicated), so the
103	  arrival count is uniform.
104	
105	- **Real multi-GPU (`NvshmemTransport`, the 8×H100 run):** each GPU runs its own
106	  grid over the FULL `T` (activations are replicated across TP ranks — TP shards
107	  WEIGHTS, not the batch). `n_tiles` is identical on every GPU, and within a GPU
108	  every CTA does the same `n_rounds`. The `bar.sync()` is intra-GPU (the

176	    st.ema        = extra_slice;          // grokfast/grokadamw slow-grad EMA
177	    // NeuralGrok psi-net pack (kPsiPackFloats floats at the head of `extra`): the
178	    // cell places [psi_W1 | psi_b1 | psi_W2 | psi_b2] there; bind the device pointers
179	    // so the apply reads real weights (psi_b2 is read on-device from psi_W2[kPsiHidden]).
180	    st.psi_W1     = extra_slice + kPsiW1Off;
181	    st.psi_b1     = extra_slice + kPsiB1Off;
182	    st.psi_W2     = extra_slice + kPsiW2Off;

184	    // to [m | v | extra/s_track | loss | param_init | r_ema | s_ema | d_lr] (host
185	    // sizes it to >= 4*total + 4; see dispatch.fused_train_step). The `extra` slice
186	    // doubles as Prodigy's `s` trajectory accumulator (the apply reads st.s_track,
187	    // not st.ema — they alias here, harmless: Prodigy has no slow-grad EMA). The
188	    // trajectory anchor p0 (param_init) follows the loss slot; the 3 persisted
189	    // estimator scalars [r_ema | s_ema | d_lr] follow param_init. loss_out points at
190	    // state+3*total (dispatch's loss_slot), so param_init = loss_out + 1.
191	    st.s_track        = extra_slice;            // Prodigy `s` (per-element accumulator)
192	    st.param_init     = loss_out + 1;           // state + 3*total + 1
193	    st.prodigy_persist = loss_out + 1 + total;  // [r_ema | s_ema | d_lr]
194	    // LookSAM (MODEL-COUPLED SAM 2nd backward): sam_dir is the PERSISTENT cached SAM
195	    // direction (g_sam − g), carried across steps in the `extra` slice (aliases the
196	    // grokfast EMA / Prodigy s_track slot — harmless: LookSAM has none of those). The
197	    // in-kernel P2.4 phase WRITES it on SAM steps; the apply tail READS it every step.
198	    st.sam_dir        = extra_slice;            // [total] cached SAM direction
199	    // SuperGrok11/15 (MODEL-COUPLED SAM 2nd backward + per-tensor meta-net mu). State
200	    // layout: [m | v | mu | loss | sharpness(total) | phi_pack(4H+1)].
201	    //   * st.mu = the `extra` slice (recomputed each step by the P2.45 precompute; the
202	    //     apply reads it — it aliases sam_dir/ema/s_track, harmless: SG has none).
203	    //   * st.sharpness = loss_slot+1 (PERSISTED (g_sam−g)²; the P2.4 SAM 2nd backward
204	    //     writes it on SAM steps, the cached value is reused on intervening steps).
205	    //   * st.sg_phi_W1/b1/W2 = the phi pack at sharpness+total (host-scattered each step,
206	    //     like NeuralGrok's psi pack); sg_phi_b2 is read on-device from sg_phi_W2[H].
207	    st.mu             = extra_slice;            // [total] meta-net mu (P2.45-filled)
208	    {
209	        float* sharp_base = loss_out + 1;       // state + 3*total + 1
210	        float* phi_base   = sharp_base + total; // phi pack after sharpness
211	        st.sharpness = sharp_base;
212	        st.sg_phi_W1 = phi_base + kSgPhiW1Off;
213	        st.sg_phi_b1 = phi_base + kSgPhiB1Off;
214	        st.sg_phi_W2 = phi_base + kSgPhiW2Off;  // sg_phi_b2 read on-device from [H]
215	    }
216	    apply_scalars(st, scalars);   // FULL scalar set (un-frozen bc1/bc2/... + d0/d_coef/beta3 + rho/looksam_sam/sg_rescale)
217	    st.lr = lr;

220	    tok.tokens    = tokens;
221	    tok.targets   = targets;
222	    tok.B         = B;
223	    tok.workspace = sc.workspace;
224	    tok.loss_out  = loss_out;

227	    // these OptIds; the template differs ONLY in the P3 apply_optimizer<Opt> tail.
228	    // Unsupported opt_ids return cudaErrorInvalidValue → dispatch.cpp throws LOUD (no
229	    // silent scalar/adamw fallback — the no-suppression rule). The STAGED/model-coupled
230	    // optimizers are intentionally NOT cases here (they cannot run as a single launch).

232	        case OptId::AdamW:
233	#if defined(SG_HAS_NVSHMEM)

238	                using ParTP8 = ::sg::fused::par::ParConfig<

240	                    ::sg::fused::par::ZeROStage::Z3>;
241	                // Symmetric TP-slot heap: one publish+reduced slot per CTA-in-PE.
242	                // WORLD-UNIFORM stride (every PE agrees) = ctas_per_pe·2·kTileM·d.

244	                const int ctas_per_pe = nCTA / P;   // launcher asserts nCTA % P == 0

250	                comm.tp_rank = nvshmem_team_my_pe(/*TP team*/NVSHMEM_TEAM_WORLD);
251	                comm.tp_sym_heap = sc.tp_sym_heap;
252	                comm.tp_heap_stride_floats = sym_floats;
253	                comm.tp_team_n_pes  = 8;
254	                comm.tp_team_local_pe = comm.tp_rank;

257	                // the real team — NVSHMEM_TEAM_WORLD for the single-node pure-TP run.

265	                ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
266	        case OptId::Lion:
267	            return launch_fused_decoder_megakernel_tc<OptId::Lion>(
268	                ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
269	        case OptId::Grokfast:

272	        case OptId::GrokAdamW:

275	        case OptId::NeuralGrok:

278	        case OptId::Prodigy:
279	            // STAGED global-d: the SAME single persistent launch — the d-estimate
280	            // cross-tensor reduction is an IN-KERNEL phase (P2.6, between B2 and P3),
281	            // not a separate launch. st carries param_init/prodigy_persist/d0/d_coef/
282	            // beta3; the kernel decays+accumulates the EMA, updates d, applies.
283	            return launch_fused_decoder_megakernel_tc<OptId::Prodigy>(
284	                ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
285	        case OptId::Muon:
286	            // STAGED grid-cooperative Newton-Schulz (wave-2 decoder lane): the SAME
287	            // single persistent launch — the NS orthogonalization of the 11 2D weights
288	            // (tok/pos/in_proj/out_proj/ff.0/ff.2/out) is an IN-KERNEL phase (P2.7,
289	            // between B2/P2.6 and P3), grid-barrier-looped per matrix, NOT a separate
290	            // launch. The per-matrix NS scratch lives in the workspace (dec_tc_muon_floats,
291	            // carved after the Prodigy reduce slots). The persistent momentum buffer is
292	            // the m-slice (st.exp_avg); the 1D/non-2D weights take the AdamW tail in P3
293	            // reading the INDEPENDENT aux_lr/aux_betas (eager Muon adamw_* group). The
294	            // vit twin (mega_vit_real_adamw_tc_launcher.cu) proved this routing.
295	            return launch_fused_decoder_megakernel_tc<OptId::Muon>(
296	                ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
297	        case OptId::LookSAM:
298	            // MODEL-COUPLED SAM 2nd backward (wave-2 decoder lane): the SAME single
299	            // persistent launch — the perturb→2nd in-kernel fwd+bwd→sam_dir=g_sam−g is
300	            // an IN-KERNEL phase (P2.4, between B2 and P2.5/P3), gated to every-k SAM
301	            // steps by st.looksam_sam. The transient backup + g_sam buffers live in the
302	            // workspace (dec_tc_looksam_floats, carved after the Muon scratch); sam_dir
303	            // persists in the extra slice (st.sam_dir, bound above). The apply tail (P3)
304	            // blends g_adj=(1−α)g+α·sam_dir and runs AdamW. NOT a separate launch.
305	            return launch_fused_decoder_megakernel_tc<OptId::LookSAM>(
306	                ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
307	        case OptId::SuperGrok11:
308	            // MODEL-COUPLED SAM 2nd backward + per-tensor meta-net mu/gate (wave-3
309	            // decoder lane): the SAME single persistent launch. The SAM 2nd backward
310	            // (P2.4, sharpness=(g_sam−g)²) + the per-tensor mu precompute (P2.45,
311	            // mu=rescale·phi(g,sharpness)) + the per-tensor cosine gate are ALL
312	            // in-kernel phases between B2 and P3; the apply tail (sg11_sweep_b_step:
313	            // smart_grad=g+(1−gate)·alpha·mu, AdamW) runs in P3. The SAM scratch reuses
314	            // the looksam buffers (dec_tc_looksam_floats); sharpness + the phi pack ride
315	            // the extended state buffer (bound above). NOT a separate launch.
316	            return launch_fused_decoder_megakernel_tc<OptId::SuperGrok11>(

318	        case OptId::SuperGrok15:

320	            // is a host scalar (st.gate = sigmoid(accuracy)), NO per-tensor cosine stage;
321	            // the apply tail (sg15_sweep_b_step) does the per-coord alpha clip + smart_grad
322	            // = g + gate·a·mu + AdamW. Single persistent launch.
323	            return launch_fused_decoder_megakernel_tc<OptId::SuperGrok15>(
324	                ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);

335	cudaError_t mega_decoder_real_adamw_tc(
336	        PersistentContext ctx, float* params,
337	        const int* tokens, const int* targets, int B,
338	        float* state, float* grad, float* workspace_unused, float* loss_out,
339	        const int* sizes, const int* offsets,
340	        float lr, int step, const FusedScalars& scalars, cudaStream_t stream,

343	        ctx, params, tokens, targets, B, state, grad, workspace_unused, loss_out,
344	        sizes, offsets, lr, step, scalars, stream, ncta_cap, opt_id, /*tp_size=*/1);

347	// mega_decoder_sg2_tc — the DEDICATED SuperGrok2 TC launcher. SG2 needs the FULL
348	// CSA/HCA/PEER/GRU meta-net weight bundle (26 HBM pointers, model-independent) +
349	// per-tensor scalar ARRAYS (alpha/gru_decay/lamb_eff/beta1/bc1/bc2, length P) +
350	// the meta-net state (m/v/mu/slow/gru_state/sharpness), none of which fit the
351	// FusedScalars POD or the generic mega_decoder_real_adamw_tc boundary. So this is
352	// a PARALLEL entry (the generic launcher + the 28 byte-identical cells are
353	// UNTOUCHED). It binds the SG2 state slices, threads the weight bundle + scalar
354	// arrays through FusedOptState's sg2_* fields, and dispatches the OptId::SuperGrok2
355	// kernel instantiation (its P3-SG2 phase runs sg2_meta_stages per tensor: STAGE -1
356	// in-kernel segmented sort → CSA/HCA/GRU/PEER/apply, reading st.sharpness from the
357	// SAM 2nd backward (P2.4, shared with SG11/15)).
358	//
359	// STATE LAYOUT (host sizes it; this carves it):
360	//   [m(total) | v(total) | mu(total) | loss(1) | sharpness(total) | slow(total)
361	//    | gru_state(total*GH)]   ⇒ min_state = (4+1+GH)*total + 1   (GH=gru_hidden=4)
362	// perm/unsort are built IN-KERNEL into the per-CTA workspace (NOT state).
363	cudaError_t mega_decoder_sg2_tc(
364	        PersistentContext ctx, float* params,
365	        const int* tokens, const int* targets, int B,
366	        float* state, float* grad, float* loss_out,
367	        // SG2 meta-net weight bundle (HBM, fp32, model-independent), in SG2Weights order.
368	        const float* input_proj_W, const float* input_proj_b,
369	        const float* csa_q_W, const float* csa_k_W, const float* csa_v_W, const float* csa_out_W,
370	        const float* csa_compress_w, const float* csa_idx_DQ, const float* csa_idx_K,
371	        const float* hca_q_W, const float* hca_k_W, const float* hca_v_W, const float* hca_out_W,
372	        const float* gru_Wz, const float* gru_bz, const float* gru_Wr, const float* gru_br,
373	        const float* gru_Wh, const float* gru_bh,
374	        const float* peer_query_Ws, const float* prod_keys_A, const float* prod_keys_B,
375	        const float* expert_W1, const float* expert_b1, const float* expert_W2, const float* expert_b2,
376	        // per-tensor scalar arrays (device, length kDecNumTensors).
377	        const float* sc_alpha, const float* sc_gru_decay, const float* sc_lamb_eff,
378	        const float* sc_beta1, const float* sc_bc1, const float* sc_bc2,
379	        // shared scalars + the SAM 2nd-backward gate (SG2 reuses the LookSAM P2.4
380	        // machinery: rho = perturbation radius, sam_on = every-k SAM-step gate).
381	        float rescale, float beta2, float lr, float wd, float eps,
382	        float rho, float sam_on,
383	        int step, cudaStream_t stream, int ncta_cap) {
384	    const int64_t total = kDecTotalElems;
385	    // gru_state spans total*GH (GH=DecSG2Dims::gru_hidden); the layout is fixed by
386	    // the kernel's SG2State carve, so the slices below need no GH arithmetic here.
387	    const int T = B * dec::kSeq;
388	
389	    int dev = 0;
390	    cudaError_t err = cudaGetDevice(&dev);
391	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
392	    int n_sms = 1;
393	    err = cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&n_sms, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, dev);
394	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
395	    int nCTA = n_sms;
396	    if (ncta_cap > 0 && ncta_cap < nCTA) nCTA = ncta_cap;
397	
398	    const int64_t need = dec_tc_workspace_floats(T, B, nCTA);
399	    DecTcLauncherScratch& sc = dec_tc_launcher_scratch(dev, need);
400	    ctx.g_next_task   = sc.g_next;
401	    ctx.g_arrived     = sc.g_arrived;
402	    ctx.g_generation  = sc.g_generation;
403	    ctx.n_tasks       = kDecNumTensors;
404	
405	    // Bind the SG2 state slices: [m | v | mu | loss | sharpness | slow | gru_state].
406	    FusedOptState st;
407	    st.exp_avg     = state;                       // m
408	    st.exp_avg_sq  = state + total;               // v
409	    st.mu          = state + 2 * total;           // expert-output EMA
410	    // loss_out points at state + 3*total (dispatch's loss slot).
411	    float* sharp_base = loss_out + 1;             // state + 3*total + 1
412	    st.sharpness   = sharp_base;                  // (g_sam − g)² (SAM 2nd backward, P2.4)
413	    st.sg2_slow    = sharp_base + total;          // grokfast slow-grad EMA
414	    st.sg2_gru_state = st.sg2_slow + total;       // [total*GH] per-element GRU state
415	    // meta-net weight bundle (HBM).
416	    st.sg2_input_proj_W = input_proj_W; st.sg2_input_proj_b = input_proj_b;
417	    st.sg2_csa_q_W = csa_q_W; st.sg2_csa_k_W = csa_k_W; st.sg2_csa_v_W = csa_v_W;
418	    st.sg2_csa_out_W = csa_out_W; st.sg2_csa_compress_w = csa_compress_w;
419	    st.sg2_csa_idx_DQ = csa_idx_DQ; st.sg2_csa_idx_K = csa_idx_K;
420	    st.sg2_hca_q_W = hca_q_W; st.sg2_hca_k_W = hca_k_W; st.sg2_hca_v_W = hca_v_W;
421	    st.sg2_hca_out_W = hca_out_W;
422	    st.sg2_gru_Wz = gru_Wz; st.sg2_gru_bz = gru_bz; st.sg2_gru_Wr = gru_Wr;
423	    st.sg2_gru_br = gru_br; st.sg2_gru_Wh = gru_Wh; st.sg2_gru_bh = gru_bh;
424	    st.sg2_peer_query_Ws = peer_query_Ws; st.sg2_prod_keys_A = prod_keys_A;
425	    st.sg2_prod_keys_B = prod_keys_B;
426	    st.sg2_expert_W1 = expert_W1; st.sg2_expert_b1 = expert_b1;
427	    st.sg2_expert_W2 = expert_W2; st.sg2_expert_b2 = expert_b2;
428	    // per-tensor scalar arrays.
429	    st.sg2_alpha = sc_alpha; st.sg2_gru_decay = sc_gru_decay; st.sg2_lamb_eff = sc_lamb_eff;
430	    st.sg2_beta1 = sc_beta1; st.sg2_bc1 = sc_bc1; st.sg2_bc2 = sc_bc2;
431	    st.sg2_rescale = rescale;
432	    // shared scalars the SG2 phase reads (beta2/lr/wd/eps via FusedScalars fields).
433	    st.beta2 = beta2; st.lr = lr; st.wd = wd; st.eps = eps;
434	    // SAM 2nd-backward gate: SG2 reuses the LookSAM P2.4 machinery. st.rho is the
435	    // perturbation radius (SG2's sam_rho); st.looksam_sam is the every-k SAM-step gate
436	    // (1.0 ⇒ run the in-kernel perturb→2nd fwd+bwd→sharpness=(g_sam−g)² this step;
437	    // 0.0 ⇒ reuse the cached sharpness). On a non-SAM step the cached sharpness feeds
438	    // the meta-net verbatim (eager-faithful).
439	    st.rho = rho;
440	    st.looksam_sam = sam_on;
441	
442	    DecoderTokenCtx tok;
443	    tok.tokens    = tokens;
444	    tok.targets   = targets;
445	    tok.B         = B;
446	    tok.workspace = sc.workspace;
447	    tok.loss_out  = loss_out;
448	
449	    return launch_fused_decoder_megakernel_tc<OptId::SuperGrok2>(
450	        ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st, stream, nCTA);
451	}

102	// ── Exact-erf GELU + derivative (the real nn.GELU(), NOT the tanh surrogate). ──
103	__device__ __forceinline__ float vit_gelu(float x) {
104	    return 0.5f * x * (1.0f + erff(x * (float)M_SQRT1_2));
105	}
106	__device__ __forceinline__ float vit_gelu_grad(float x) {
107	    const float cdf = 0.5f * (1.0f + erff(x * (float)M_SQRT1_2));
108	    const float inv_sqrt_2pi = 0.39894228040143270286f;  // 1/sqrt(2*pi)
109	    const float pdf = inv_sqrt_2pi * __expf(-0.5f * x * x);
110	    return cdf + x * pdf;
111	}

142	// at `off` within the flat [m|v|extra] layout. Per-TENSOR fields and all scalars

147	__device__ __forceinline__ FusedOptState
148	vit_rebase_state(const FusedOptState& s, int64_t off) {
149	    FusedOptState t = s;  // scalars + per-tensor pointers copy as-is
150	    if (t.exp_avg)    t.exp_avg    += off;
151	    if (t.exp_avg_sq) t.exp_avg_sq += off;
152	    if (t.ema)        t.ema        += off;

154	    if (t.s_track)    t.s_track    += off;

158	    if (t.param_init) t.param_init += off;   // Prodigy trajectory anchor p0

193	fused_vit_megakernel(PersistentContext ctx,
194	                     float* __restrict__ params,
195	                     ViTInputCtx in,
196	                     float* __restrict__ grad,        // reduced grad [total]
197	                     float lr, int step, FusedOptState st) {

199	    VitSampleSmem& sm = *reinterpret_cast<VitSampleSmem*>(vit_smem_raw);

205	    float* loss_part = in.workspace + (int64_t)nCTA * total;   // [nCTA]

212	    // ── P0: zero this CTA's grad-partial slice + its loss slot. ───────────────
213	    for (int64_t i = threadIdx.x; i < total; i += blockDim.x) my_partial[i] = 0.0f;
214	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = 0.0f;

217	    // ── P1: batch-parallel fwd+bwd. Fixed contiguous slice [b0,b1) for this CTA.
218	    VitWeights w = vit_bind(params);
219	    VitGrad g = vit_bind_grad(my_partial);
220	    const int B = in.B;
221	    const int base = B / nCTA, rem = B % nCTA;

223	    const int cnt = base + (cta < rem ? 1 : 0);

226	    float nll_acc = 0.0f;              // fp32 slice accumulator (thread-0 holds it)
227	    const int patch_elems = vit::kNPatch * vit::kPatch;   // 16*49 = 784
228	    for (int b = b0; b < b1; ++b) {
229	        // Load this sample's float patches into smem (cooperative).
230	        const float* src = in.patches + (int64_t)b * patch_elems;
231	        for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < patch_elems; i += blockDim.x)
232	            sm.patch[i / vit::kPatch][i % vit::kPatch] = src[i];
233	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) tgt_s = in.targets[b];

235	        float nll = vit_forward_sample(w, tgt_s, &sm);
236	        vit_backward_sample(w, g, tgt_s, B, &sm);

238	        __syncthreads();   // sample boundary: all grad writes done before reuse
239	    }
240	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = nll_acc;
241	    bar.sync();   // B1: all CTA partials + loss slots complete
242	
243	    // ── P2: deterministic cross-CTA reduce. Work-steal the param ELEMENT-RANGES
244	    //    (one task = one parameter tensor; sum its elements across CTAs in
245	    //    ascending CTA index). Summation ORDER (ascending cta) is fixed →
246	    //    deterministic regardless of which CTA grabs the task. ─────────────────
247	    {
248	        __shared__ int task_slot;
249	        TaskQueue q = ctx.queue();
250	        for (int t = q.next_block(&task_slot); t < kVitNumTensors;
251	             t = q.next_block(&task_slot)) {
252	            const int n = kVitSizes[t];
253	            const int64_t off = (int64_t)kVitOffsets[t];
254	            for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < n; i += blockDim.x) {
255	                float acc = 0.0f;
256	                for (int c = 0; c < nCTA; ++c)
257	                    acc += in.workspace[(int64_t)c * total + off + i];
258	                grad[off + i] = acc;
259	            }
260	        }

263	    // tightest gate; fp32 atomic-summing many terms can miss it.
264	    if (cta == 0 && threadIdx.x == 0) {
265	        double s = 0.0;
266	        for (int c = 0; c < nCTA; ++c) s += (double)loss_part[c];
267	        float mean = (float)(s / (double)B);
268	        *in.loss_out = mean;

270	    bar.sync_reset(ctx.g_next_task);   // B2: reduced grad ready; reset queue for P3

273	    //    tensors). apply_optimizer<Opt> is the canonical csrc/algorithms math. ──

278	        for (int t = q.next_block(&task_slot); t < kVitNumTensors;

292	//    Mirrors launch_fused_decoder_megakernel's hang-freedom contract (occupancy≥1
293	//    or refuse), PLUS the DYNAMIC-SMEM opt-in that the ViT footprint requires:
294	//      (1) cudaFuncSetAttribute(MaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, sizeof(VitSampleSmem))
295	//      (2) dynamicSMemBytes = sizeof(VitSampleSmem) in the occ≥1 query
296	//      (3) dynamicSMemBytes = sizeof(VitSampleSmem) at <<<...>>>
297	//    All three are mandatory; missing any one makes the launch silently fail. ───
298	template <OptId Opt>
299	cudaError_t launch_fused_vit_megakernel(
300	        PersistentContext ctx, float* params, ViTInputCtx in,
301	        float* grad, float lr, int step, FusedOptState st, cudaStream_t stream) {
302	    int dev = 0;
303	    cudaError_t err = cudaGetDevice(&dev);
304	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
305	    int n_sms = 0;
306	    err = cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&n_sms, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, dev);
307	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
308	
309	    const int dyn_smem = (int)sizeof(VitSampleSmem);   // ≈ 188080 B (183.67 KB)
310	
311	    // (1) Opt in to >48 KB dynamic smem for THIS kernel. Without this the launch
312	    //     fails with cudaErrorInvalidValue (the static 48 KB default applies).
313	    err = cudaFuncSetAttribute(
314	        (const void*)&fused_vit_megakernel<Opt>,
315	        cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, dyn_smem);
316	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
317	
318	    // (2) Occupancy with the REAL dynamic-smem request (hang-freedom is honest).
319	    int occ = 0;
320	    err = cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(
321	        &occ, (const void*)&fused_vit_megakernel<Opt>, SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK,
322	        /*dynamicSMemBytes=*/dyn_smem);
323	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
324	    // At least one CTA per SM must be resident or the grid barrier can never be
325	    // satisfied. ~183.67 KB dynamic smem fits the sm_90 227 KB cap at occ=1 (the
326	    // persistent megakernel is one-CTA-per-SM by design); if it cannot place one
327	    // block/SM, REFUSE rather than hang.
328	    assert(occ >= 1 &&
329	           "fused_vit_megakernel: 0 blocks/SM — GridBarrier would hang. The ViT "
330	           "per-sample smem (~184KB dynamic) + regs exceed one-block-per-SM "
331	           "occupancy on this device; reduce footprint or fall back to eager.");
332	    if (occ < 1) return cudaErrorLaunchOutOfResources;
333	
334	    const unsigned launch_ctas = (unsigned)n_sms;
335	    ctx.n_ctas = launch_ctas;
336	
337	    if (ctx.g_arrived) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_arrived, 0, sizeof(unsigned), stream); if (err) return err; }
338	    if (ctx.g_generation) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_generation, 0, sizeof(unsigned), stream); if (err) return err; }
339	    if (ctx.g_next_task) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_next_task, 0, sizeof(int), stream); if (err) return err; }
340	
341	    // (3) Launch WITH the dynamic-smem byte count.
342	    dim3 grid(launch_ctas), block(SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK);
343	    fused_vit_megakernel<Opt><<<grid, block, dyn_smem, stream>>>(
344	        ctx, params, in, grad, lr, step, st);
345	    return cudaGetLastError();
346	}
347	#endif  // SG_VIT_SCALAR_MEGAKERNEL

349	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
350	//  WGMMA CELL DRIVER (DESIGN-TC-PIPELINE.md Fork B, the ViT twin of the decoder
351	//  R2.3 driver). Compiled only under the wgmma token; the scalar path above is
352	//  untouched. The TC path's per-CTA tile scratch lives in HBM (NOT dynamic smem)
353	//  — the only smem the TC kernel needs is the tiny wgmma staging arena (one
354	//  A(64×16) + one B(N×16) bf16 tile + a 256-float reduction + the 10 dW specs),
355	//  which is STATIC (≈ 7 KB), so this kernel — unlike the scalar ViT one — needs
356	//  NO dynamic-smem opt-in. The big ViT activation footprint (which forced the
357	//  scalar path to 184 KB dynamic smem) becomes HBM acts here (Fork B), so the
358	//  occupancy story is the decoder TC one: static smem, 0 dynamic.
359	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
360	#if (SG_TUNED_GEMM_IMPL == SG_GEMM_IMPL_WGMMA)
361	
362	// TC megakernel threads: 256 (the engine's producer+consumer warpgroup layout;
363	// wgmma is warpgroup-scoped on threads 0..127). We do NOT apply the scalar
364	// path's asymmetric setmaxnreg (it would STARVE the MMA warpgroup); the
365	// validated selftest ran no split. We match it.
366	#define SG_VIT_TC_MEGA_BLOCK 256
367	
368	// ── smem arena for the unpipelined engine. The M-atom-interleaved wgmma pipeline
369	//    (task #24, decoder H1+H3 port) stages kVitAtomsPerSlot A(64×16) tiles per
370	//    k-step (one per stacked m64 atom in an interleave GROUP, issued back-to-back
371	//    into independent fp32 fragments so the tensor pipe overlaps them; atom-in-
372	//    group ai at sA + ai·kVitTcSmemA1) + ONE shared B(N×16) tile. kVitAtomsPerSlot
373	//    = kVitMaxIL (the interleave cap, default 2). Plus the 256-float reduction slot
374	//    + the 10 dW specs (identical for all threads → shared, not per-thread stack).
375	//    16B-aligned. N = SG_TUNED_TILE_N. ──
376	struct VitTcSmem {
377	    __nv_bfloat16 sA[vittc::kVitAtomsPerSlot * 64 * 16];
378	    __nv_bfloat16 sB[SG_TUNED_TILE_N * 16];
379	    float red[256];
380	    vittc::VitDwSpec spec[vittc::kVitNumDwSpecs];
381	};
382	
383	// ── TC workspace layout (carved from in.workspace; the host sizes it). Regions
384	//    (float units):
385	//      [0 .. acts_f)                      : VitActs bf16 region (reinterpreted)
386	//      [acts_f .. acts_f + nCTA*scratch)  : per-CTA tile scratch (f32)
387	//      [.. + nCTA*kLnVecElems)            : per-CTA LN-vec partials (f32)
388	//      [.. + nCTA)                        : per-CTA loss slots (f32)
389	//      [.. + 1)                           : reduced scalar loss (host reads it)
390	//    acts_f = ceil(acts_bf16 / 2). ──
391	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_acts_floats(int T, int B) {
392	    return (vittc::vit_acts_bf16_count(T, B) + 1) / 2;
393	}
394	// dW split-K partial floats (0 when G==1 → no extra scratch, the single-CTA path).
395	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_dw_part_floats() {
396	    return vittc::vit_dw_part_floats(vittc::kVitDwSplitK);
397	}
398	// The d-scaled BENCH layout (SG_VIT_BENCH_LAYOUT=1) is adamw-ONLY (vit_bench.py /
399	// scripts/roofline_bench.py drive OptId::AdamW exclusively — none of the four staged
400	// optimizers ever runs in the bench TU), so carving them there is pure dead weight.
401	// At bench width the SG2 region in particular is pathological: vit_sg2_ws_stride_floats()
402	// is O(Nmax·d_model) PER CTA and Nmax=4d²·… grows with d ⇒ ~565 GB over 132 CTAs at
403	// d=2048, OOMing the 80 GB H100 (the SAME deep limit the decoder twin documents at
404	// dec_tc_sg2_floats — SG2's per-CTA workspace DESIGN doesn't scale; a chunked/streamed
405	// restructure is the documented deep item, out of scope here). So we GATE the four
406	// regions OFF at bench width: honest scoping (the bench never touches them), NOT
407	// correctness suppression. PRODUCTION is byte-identical — kVitStagedOptScratch is true
408	// there, so every gated helper folds back to its original value (constexpr bool, -O3
409	// inline). This mirrors the decoder's kDecStagedOptScratch (fused_decoder_megakernel.cuh).
410	#if SG_VIT_BENCH_LAYOUT
411	constexpr bool kVitStagedOptScratch = false;   // bench: adamw-only → elide the 4 staged-opt carves
412	#else
413	constexpr bool kVitStagedOptScratch = true;    // production: carve all 4 (opt-agnostic launcher)
414	#endif
415	// STAGED-optimizer cross-CTA reduction scratch (Prodigy d-estimate). The Prodigy
416	// stage publishes per-CTA (r,s) slots (2*nCTA) + a reduced-d slot (1) — an owner-
417	// computes tree (opt_stages_precompute.cuh), NO float atomic. Sized for the LARGEST
418	// nCTA (one CTA/SM = #SMs); tiny (≤ 2*132+1 floats) and carved UNCONDITIONALLY so
419	// the opt-agnostic launcher allocates one workspace fitting every OptId. Unused by
420	// AdamW/Lion/… (their P3 never touches it) → those cells stay byte-identical.
421	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_opt_reduce_floats(int nCTA) {
422	    if (!kVitStagedOptScratch) return 0;     // bench (adamw-only): Prodigy never runs
423	    return (int64_t)2 * nCTA + 1;            // [r slots | s slots | reduced d]
424	}
425	// ── Muon (STAGED grid-cooperative Newton-Schulz) per-matrix scratch. The NS chain
426	//    runs ONE 2D weight at a time over all CTAs; the scratch holds X/A/AX/AAX/orth
427	//    for the LARGEST 2D weight + the per-CTA Frobenius-norm partials + inv_norm. The
428	//    momentum buffer (muon_buf) is NOT here — it PERSISTS across steps as optimizer
429	//    state, bound to the m slice (st.exp_avg). Largest vit 2D weight: ff0/ff2 = 512×
430	//    128 = 65536 numel; largest rows = 512 ⇒ A = 512×512. Carved UNCONDITIONALLY
431	//    (≈ 4·65536 + 512² + nCTA + 1 floats ≈ 2 MB) so the opt-agnostic launcher fits
432	//    every OptId; unused by every non-Muon cell (byte-identical). ──
433	//    kVitMuonMaxNumel = max over 2D weights of rows*cols; kVitMuonMaxRows = max rows.
434	static constexpr int kVitMuonMaxNumel = vit::kDff * vit::kD;     // 512*128 = 65536 (ff0/ff2)
435	static constexpr int kVitMuonMaxRows  = vit::kDff;               // 512 (ff0 rows)
436	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_muon_floats(int nCTA) {
437	    if (!kVitStagedOptScratch) return 0;     // bench (adamw-only): Muon never runs
438	    // X + AX + AAX + orth (each maxNumel) + A (maxRows²) + nrm_partials(nCTA) + inv_norm(1)
439	    return (int64_t)4 * kVitMuonMaxNumel
440	         + (int64_t)kVitMuonMaxRows * kVitMuonMaxRows
441	         + nCTA + 1;
442	}
443	// ── LookSAM (STAGED in-kernel SAM 2nd backward) transient scratch — the ViT twin of
444	//    the decoder's dec_tc_looksam_floats (fused_decoder_megakernel.cuh). The SAM step
445	//    perturbs p in place, runs a SECOND fwd+bwd at p', and needs (a) a param BACKUP for
446	//    the exact restore (eager clones p before perturbing; an fp32 add is not bit-
447	//    reversible, so save — don't subtract back) + (b) a SEPARATE g_sam grad buffer so
448	//    the 2nd backward does NOT clobber the first grad `grad` (sam_dir = g_sam − grad
449	//    reads both). Both are total-sized + transient (NOT persistent state — sam_dir
450	//    itself persists in the `extra` state slice, bound by the cell). Carved
451	//    UNCONDITIONALLY (≈ 2·kVitTotalElems ≈ 3.3 MB) so the opt-agnostic launcher fits
452	//    every OptId; unused by every non-LookSAM cell (its P2.4 phase is if-constexpr'd
453	//    out → byte-identical). The ‖g‖ reduction reuses the loss workspace (sq_part/ron_bc,
454	//    as GrokAdamW's P2.5 / the decoder twin do), so no extra here. ──
455	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_looksam_floats() {
456	    if (!kVitStagedOptScratch) return 0;      // bench (adamw-only): LookSAM never runs
457	    return (int64_t)2 * kVitTotalElems;       // [sam_backup | sam_grad]
458	}
459	// ── SuperGrok2 — the ViT twin of dec_tc_sg2_floats. Weights from HBM; the only SG2
460	//    workspace is the per-CTA meta-net scratch (sized for the largest tensor) + the
461	//    row_off64 staging prefix (kVitNumTensors int64 = 2*N floats — the adapter that
462	//    builds SG2State.row_off (const int64_t*) from __constant__ int kVitOffsets). ──
463	using VitSG2Dims = SG2Dims<>;
464	// max(kVitSizes), re-derived from the layout table (vit_layout.cuh) so the SAME SG2
465	// tail is correctly sized at ANY ladder width — was a d=128-pinned 65536.
466	constexpr int kVitSG2Nmax = kVitMaxTensorNumel;   // == vit_layout_check::max_size()
467	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_sg2_ws_stride_floats() {
468	    return (int64_t)2 * kVitNumTensors
469	         + sg2_ws_stride<VitSG2Dims>((int64_t)kVitSG2Nmax);
470	}
471	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_sg2_floats(int nCTA) {
472	    if (!kVitStagedOptScratch) return 0;     // bench (adamw-only): SG2 never runs — and
473	        // its honestly-derived per-CTA stride (O(Nmax·d_model)) would OOM at large d.
474	    // +1 for the 8-byte realignment slack of sg2_ws_base (kVitTotalElems is odd).
475	    return (int64_t)nCTA * vit_sg2_ws_stride_floats() + 1;
476	}
477	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_workspace_floats(int T, int B, int nCTA) {
478	    return vit_tc_acts_floats(T, B)
479	         + (int64_t)nCTA * vittc::vit_tile_scratch_total_f32()
480	         + (int64_t)nCTA * vittc::kLnVecElems
481	         + nCTA + 1
482	         + vit_tc_dw_part_floats()           // split-K dW partials (G>1)
483	         + vit_tc_opt_reduce_floats(nCTA)    // STAGED-opt (Prodigy) reduce slots
484	         + vit_tc_muon_floats(nCTA)          // STAGED-opt (Muon) NS per-matrix scratch
485	         + vit_tc_looksam_floats()           // STAGED-opt (LookSAM) SAM 2nd-bwd scratch
486	         + vit_tc_sg2_floats(nCTA);          // SuperGrok2 meta-net per-CTA scratch (carve-LAST)
487	}

489	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
490	// Diagnostic-only (behind SG_VIT_PROFILE; NEVER on the shipped path): per-phase
491	// clock64() deltas, max across CTAs (= critical-path duration per phase). Slots:
492	// [0]=P1 fwd, [1]=P1 bwd, [2]=B1 barrier wait, [3]=P2 dW-GEMM loop,
493	// [4]=P2 grad-assembly (biases+clspos+lnvec+loss), [5]=P3 opt tail. Read
494	// host-side via cudaMemcpyFromSymbol. clock64() is per-SM; a CTA stays on one SM
495	// so its own deltas are valid; atomicMax across CTAs gives the slowest CTA per
496	// phase.
497	__device__ unsigned long long g_vit_prof_max[6];
498	#endif

500	template <OptId Opt>
501	__global__ void __launch_bounds__(SG_VIT_TC_MEGA_BLOCK)
502	fused_vit_megakernel_tc(PersistentContext ctx,
503	                        float* __restrict__ params,
504	                        ViTInputCtx in,
505	                        float* __restrict__ grad,
506	                        float lr, int step, FusedOptState st) {
507	    __shared__ VitTcSmem sm;
508	    GridBarrier bar = ctx.barrier();
509	    const int cta = blockIdx.x;
510	    const int nCTA = (int)ctx.n_ctas;
511	    const int B = in.B;
512	    const int T = B * vit::kSeq;
513	    const int Tp = B * vit::kNPatch;
514	
515	    // Workspace partition.
516	    float* ws = in.workspace;
517	    const int64_t acts_f = vit_tc_acts_floats(T, B);
518	    __nv_bfloat16* acts_base = reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16*>(ws);
519	    float* scratch_base = ws + acts_f;
520	    const int64_t scratch_per = vittc::vit_tile_scratch_total_f32();
521	    float* lnvec_base = scratch_base + (int64_t)nCTA * scratch_per;
522	    float* loss_part  = lnvec_base + (int64_t)nCTA * vittc::kLnVecElems;
523	    float* loss_out   = loss_part + nCTA;
524	    // Split-K dW partials (G>1): the (gt,kc) 64×N partial tiles, carved AFTER the
525	    // loss slot (matches vit_tc_workspace_floats's term order). G==1 → dw_part unused.
526	    float* dw_part    = loss_out + 1;
527	    const int kDwG    = vittc::kVitDwSplitK;
528	    // STAGED-opt cross-CTA reduce slots (Prodigy d), carved AFTER the dW partials
529	    // (matches vit_tc_workspace_floats's term order). Unused unless Opt==Prodigy.
530	    float* opt_reduce = dw_part + vit_tc_dw_part_floats();
531	    // Muon NS per-matrix scratch, carved AFTER the Prodigy reduce slots (matches
532	    // vit_tc_workspace_floats's term order). Unused unless Opt==Muon. Layout:
533	    //   [muon_X | muon_AX | muon_AAX | muon_orth] (each kVitMuonMaxNumel)
534	    //   [muon_A (kVitMuonMaxRows²)] [nrm_partials (nCTA)] [inv_norm (1)]
535	    float* muon_base = opt_reduce + vit_tc_opt_reduce_floats(nCTA);
536	    // LookSAM SAM 2nd-backward scratch, carved AFTER the Muon scratch (term order
537	    // matches vit_tc_workspace_floats — carving it LAST keeps every prior region's
538	    // offset unchanged, so the already-green cells are byte-identical). Layout:
539	    //   [sam_backup (total)] [sam_grad (total)]. Unused unless Opt==LookSAM.
540	    float* sam_backup = muon_base + vit_tc_muon_floats(nCTA);
541	    float* sam_grad   = sam_backup + kVitTotalElems;
542	    // SuperGrok2 meta-net per-CTA scratch, carved AFTER the LookSAM sam_grad (term
543	    // order matches vit_tc_workspace_floats — carve-LAST keeps every prior region's
544	    // offset unchanged, so the already-green cells are byte-identical). ALIGN to 8
545	    // bytes (the per-CTA slice fronts an int64 row_off64 staging array; kVitTotalElems
546	    // is odd so sam_grad+total lands on an odd float offset → an int64 read there is
547	    // misaligned). Round up to the next even float. Unused unless Opt==SuperGrok2.
548	    float* sg2_ws_base = sam_grad + kVitTotalElems;
549	    if (((uintptr_t)sg2_ws_base & 0x7) != 0) sg2_ws_base += 1;   // → 8-byte aligned
550	    (void)sg2_ws_base;   // referenced only by the SuperGrok2 P3-SG2 phase
551	
552	    vittc::VitActs acts = vittc::vit_acts_bind(acts_base, T, B);
553	    vittc::VitTileScratch sc = vittc::vit_tile_scratch_bind(scratch_base + (int64_t)cta * scratch_per);
554	    float* my_lnvec = lnvec_base + (int64_t)cta * vittc::kLnVecElems;
555	
556	    VitWeights w = vit_bind(params);
557	
558	    // ── P0: zero this CTA's LN-vec partials + loss slot (dW/cls/pos/patch grads
559	    //    are written-once → no pre-zero). ──
560	    for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < vittc::kLnVecElems; i += blockDim.x) my_lnvec[i] = 0.0f;
561	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = 0.0f;
562	    // STAGED-opt (Prodigy) reduce slots: INTEGRATION-OPTSTAGES.md §1 REQUIRES
563	    // prodigy_partials + prodigy_d zero-initialized before launch (the owner-computes
564	    // tree reads EVERY slot in ascending order; a CTA that claims no tensor in phaseA
565	    // still has its (r,s) slot read, and the persistent device workspace is NOT
566	    // re-zeroed between launches — so a stale slot from a prior step's reduction, or
567	    // garbage from the caching allocator, would make the cross-tensor d non-determi-
568	    // nistic / NaN). phaseA's block_reduce DOES write each slot, but zeroing here is
569	    // the contract guarantee + defends the prodigy_d broadcast slot. Guarded to the
570	    // Prodigy instantiation so every other cell is byte-identical (no extra work).
571	    if constexpr (Opt == OptId::Prodigy) {
572	        const int64_t n_opt = vit_tc_opt_reduce_floats(nCTA);   // 2*nCTA + 1
573	        for (int64_t i = (int64_t)cta * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; i < n_opt;
574	             i += (int64_t)nCTA * blockDim.x)
575	            opt_reduce[i] = 0.0f;
576	    }
577	    bar.sync();   // B0
578	
579	    // ── P1: token-tile-parallel fwd+bwd. Each CTA grid-strides over (sub-)tiles
580	    //    of kVitP1SubtileRows rows; for its tile it runs fwd (→ acts X, NLL) then
581	    //    bwd (→ acts dY, dh0, LN-vec partials). Barrier-free within the tile. The
582	    //    B1 load-imbalance knob (SG_TUNED_VIT_P1_SUBTILE_S) sets the sub-tile to S
583	    //    whole samples (kSeq·S rows): S=64 ⇒ kVitP1SubtileRows==kTileM==1088 ⇒
584	    //    this loop is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the whole-1088-tile schedule (n_tiles=16
585	    //    at B=1024); S<64 grows n_tiles ~64/S× so the idle CTAs (116/132 at B1024)
586	    //    pick up P1 work and the B1 spin collapses. The tile boundary stays a
587	    //    whole-sample boundary (attention stays in-tile). ──
588	    const int nrows_tile = vittc::kVitP1SubtileRows;
589	    const int n_tiles = (T + nrows_tile - 1) / nrows_tile;
590	    float nll_acc = 0.0f;
591	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
592	    unsigned long long prof_fwd = 0, prof_bwd = 0;
593	#endif
594	    for (int ti = cta; ti < n_tiles; ti += nCTA) {
595	        const int g0 = ti * nrows_tile;
596	        const int nrows = (T - g0) < nrows_tile ? (T - g0) : nrows_tile;
597	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
598	        __syncthreads(); unsigned long long _c0 = clock64();
599	#endif
600	        float nll = vittc::vittc_forward_tile(w, g0, nrows, acts, sc, in.patches, in.targets,
601	                                              sm.sA, sm.sB, sm.red);
602	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
603	        __syncthreads(); unsigned long long _c1 = clock64();
604	#endif
605	        vittc::vittc_backward_tile(w, g0, nrows, B, acts, sc, in.targets,
606	                                   my_lnvec, sc.work2, sm.sA, sm.sB, sm.red);
607	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
608	        __syncthreads(); unsigned long long _c2 = clock64();
609	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) { prof_fwd += _c1 - _c0; prof_bwd += _c2 - _c1; }
610	#endif
611	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) nll_acc += nll;
612	        __syncthreads();
613	    }
614	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = nll_acc;
615	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
616	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
617	        atomicMax(&g_vit_prof_max[0], prof_fwd);
618	        atomicMax(&g_vit_prof_max[1], prof_bwd);
619	    }
620	    unsigned long long _b1a = (threadIdx.x == 0) ? clock64() : 0;
621	#endif
622	    bar.sync();   // B1: all acts (X + dY) + LN-vec partials complete
623	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
624	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) { unsigned long long _b1b = clock64(); atomicMax(&g_vit_prof_max[2], _b1b - _b1a); }
625	#endif

627	    // ── P2: assemble all 32 grads into `grad`. dW output-stationary (gt % nCTA),
